description: This PHP class 'EmployeeLicenseService' provides service layer functionality for handling employee licenses within the OrangeHRM system. It manages an instance of 'EmployeeLicenseDao' for data access operations related to employee licenses, with methods to get and set this DAO.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseService
classes.description: Service class that manages employee license data access through an injected or internally instantiated DAO.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicenseDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeLicenseDao instance; creates a new one if not already set.

methods.name: setEmployeeLicenseDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeLicenseDao instance for the service.
